name: diet-plan-benchmark
description: A benchmark for evaluating model ability to generate personalized diet plans and meal recommendations given user constraints (preferences, allergies, goals). Tasks typically require composing multi-day meal plans, respecting nutritional constraints, and explaining choices. Useful for testing instruction-following, conditional generation, and domain-specific knowledge in nutrition.
reputation: A small community-contributed dataset on Hugging Face with limited adoption, mainly used for focused tests of diet/nutrition generation.
